items.title: SEO & GEO Specialist – Jolimont (Hybrid)
items.description:
Search is changing faster than it has in 20 years, and we want someone who’s excited about that rather than worried by it.

Distl is a Perth digital and creative agency with a 25+ person in-house team. Our clients range from builders to beauty brands, startups to ASX-listed companies. You’ll join a dedicated SEO team, not be the lone SEO in the corner, and you’ll help shape how we do GEO for every client.

What you’ll do
Own a portfolio of SEO and GEO accounts, from strategy through delivery to reporting
Run technical audits and fix what matters: site architecture, crawlability, Core Web Vitals and schema
Plan and optimise content that ranks in Google and gets cited in ChatGPT, Gemini and AI Overviews
Track AI visibility and share of voice, and turn the findings into actions
Build authority through digital PR, links and brand mentions
Present results to clients in plain English, and know which numbers actually matter to their business

What you’ll bring
3+ years in SEO, ideally agency-side across multiple clients
Hands-on GEO experience: AI visibility tracking, entity optimisation, getting brands cited in AI answers
Confidence with Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Semrush, GA4 and Search Console
Strong organisation: you can juggle accounts without dropping balls
Clear writing and reporting that clients actually read
Curiosity: you test things rather than just read about them

What’s in it for you
Competitive salary, depending on experience
Hybrid: 2 days in the office, flexible hours, no culture of overtime
A real SEO team to learn from and bounce ideas off, plus opportunity for progression
Paid birthday off and a paid volunteer day every year
Dog-friendly office, free fruit and snacks, regular breakfasts and social events
Company laptop, free parking, right by the train line
A newly renovated office in Jolimont
Hear from the team: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YHrhIa2JQnQ

To apply: send your CV and a few lines on one SEO or GEO result you’re proud of: where the site started, what you did, and what changed.

items.title: Associate Business Manager - OGM (Shift: 1:30pm - 10:30pm)
items.description:
Company: Puretech Digital

Job Title: SEO Specialist

Shift Timing: 1:30 PM - 10:30 PM

Required Skillset: Strong Communication Skills

About Us

At Puretech Digital, we’re dedicated to driving digital success through strategic SEO. We believe in the power of collaboration, knowledge-sharing, and innovation to elevate the digital landscape. We’re expanding our network and looking for skilled SEO professionals ready to make a meaningful impact.

Position Overview

We are seeking a passionate and results-driven SEO Specialist to join our dynamic team. In this hands-on role, you’ll focus on enhancing website visibility and search rankings through strategic keyword research, technical SEO, content recommendations, link acquisition, and performance reporting. You will be responsible for creating impactful SEO strategies that drive measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct comprehensive keyword research to identify high-impact opportunities with minimal guidance.
Develop keyword lists and effectively organize content themes aligned with SEO strategy.
Execute technical audits on websites, ensuring optimization of elements such as breadcrumbs, heading tags, and content accessibility.
Provide source code-level SEO recommendations to enhance website crawling and indexing.
Implement Meta and OG tags, creating contextually relevant and keyword-optimized Meta and Title tags.
Ensure all SEO documentation and recommendations are error-free and comprehensive.
Collaborate with content teams to outline detailed content requirements that align with client goals.
Demonstrate proficiency in Information Architecture, keyword density, proximity, and Latent Semantic Indexing (LSI).
Build quality backlinks with optimized anchor text, creating captivating descriptions that enhance link engagement.
Stay updated on content syndication platforms and refresh link details regularly.
Create regular reports, emphasizing keyword ranking trends, and providing error-free analysis on SEO metrics.
Investigate Bounce Rate changes, integrating insights from Google Search Console and Google Analytics to drive business improvements.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
2 to 4 years of SEO experience with proven success in improving search rankings and driving results.
Deep understanding of search engine algorithms, SEO best practices, and ranking factors.
Proficiency in SEO tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Moz, Ahrefs, etc.
Strong analytical skills to interpret SEO data, identify insights, and make data-driven decisions.
Excellent communication skills and a passion for staying updated on SEO trends and tools.

Why Join Puretech Digital?

Opportunity to work in a collaborative, innovative environment.
Evening shift to accommodate various schedules and clients across time zones.
Be part of a team that values expertise and supports career growth.

Candidates who meet the criteria and are interested, kindly share your resume at jesno.john@puretech.com.

Thank you!

items.description:
We're hiring an Jr. SEO Executive at DiMag AI Marketing Solutions, Bangalore.
You'll own organic search for real client accounts — audits you run, recommendations you write, results you're accountable for. Not a keyword-list-and-report job.
📍 Whitefield,Bangalore (Work from Office) | Full-time | 1–3 years experience
What you'll own
Technical & On-Page SEO (core)
Run technical audits — crawling and indexing, robots.txt, sitemaps, canonicals, redirects, broken links, duplicate content, page speed, Core Web Vitals, mobile usability
Optimise titles, metas, headings, URLs, internal linking and content across service, category, product and blog pages
Identify keyword cannibalisation and thin or duplicate content
Write clear technical recommendations and follow them through with developers until they ship
Keyword & Content SEO
Keyword research using Ahrefs, SEMrush and Keyword Planner — volume, difficulty, intent, opportunity gaps
Keyword mapping across the site architecture
SEO content briefs built on SERP analysis, optimised for Featured Snippets, PAA and FAQ blocks
Analytics & Reporting
GA4 and Search Console — organic traffic, impressions, clicks, CTR, rankings, landing page performance, organic conversions
Diagnose why traffic or rankings moved, not just that they did
Weekly and monthly client reports with observations and a recommended next action
Off-Page (supporting)
Competitor backlink analysis and gap identification
Support link acquisition through genuine editorial placements, digital PR and relevant citations
Maintain the backlink tracker and monitor referring domains and anchor profiles
We don't buy links or use PBNs. If a tactic wouldn't survive being explained to the client, we don't run it.
What we're looking for
1–3 years of hands-on SEO, ideally agency or multi-client
Able to run a full site audit independently and defend every recommendation in it
Comfortable in GA4 and Search Console — not just exporting, but reading
Basic HTML; enough to talk to a developer without a translator
Any degree. Portfolio and practical skill matter more than qualification
Plus points
Screaming Frog, schema markup, Looker Studio, WordPress/Shopify, basic CSS/JS, and experience using AI tools for research and content workflows.
Where this role is going
Search is changing. A growing part of this role is AEO and GEO — structuring content so it gets cited by AI search and answer engines, and building entity and topical authority rather than chasing keywords alone. You don't need experience here. You do need to be genuinely interested in figuring it out, because we're building that capability as a team.

Audit quality and recommendation accuracy • Recommendations actually implemented • Ranking keyword growth and organic visibility • Referring domain quality (not volume) • Reporting clarity and client-readiness

🔹 ما یک استارتاپ هوش مصنوعی فعال در حوزه مشتریان سازمانی هستیم و می‌خواهیم مشتریان بالقوه، متناسب با مسئله‌شان به صفحه مناسبی از سایت برسند و پاسخ روشنی دریافت کنند.
شرح کار:
• بررسی صفحات فعلی سایت، داده‌های میزفا تولز و عبارت‌های هدف کمپین‌های گوگل ادز؛ سپس انتخاب و اولویت‌بندی کلمات کلیدی با توجه به ارتباط آن‌ها با نیاز مشتریان سازمانی، حتی در مواردی که حجم جست‌وجو کم است. خروجی این بخش جدولی ساده باشد که برای هر عبارت، صفحه قابل بهبود یا مقاله پیشنهادی را مشخص کند.
• بازبینی و در صورت نیاز بازنویسی مطالب موجود و تولید مقاله‌های جدید برای موضوعات پوشش‌داده‌نشده؛ مجموع مقاله‌های بازنویسی‌شده و جدید حدود ۱۰ مورد باشد. در حال حاضر ۷ تا ۸ مقاله منتشر شده که بخشی از آن‌ها با هوش مصنوعی نوشته شده‌اند. تعداد دقیق مطالب بازنویسی‌شده و جدید و موضوعات مقاله‌های تازه با هماهنگی مشخص می‌شود.
• نگارش رپورتاژ برای ۲ تا ۳ سایت؛ پیشنهاد موضوع هر رپورتاژ و صفحه مقصد لینک و نگارش متن متناسب با مخاطب رسانه.
• همکاری در نگارش و بازنویسی محتوا تا مرحله انتشار پیش می‌رود. ابزارهای هوش مصنوعی و قالب آماده برای تهیه متن و تصویر در اختیار مجری قرار می‌گیرد و استفاده از AI مزیت محسوب می‌شود.
معیار محتوا، دقت، روانی و طبیعی‌بودن و پاسخ‌گویی به پرسش واقعی مخاطب است؛ تکرار کلمه کلیدی به‌تنهایی کافی نیست. موضوع‌ها، اولویت‌ها و رسانه‌های نهایی پس از بررسی و هماهنگی تعیین می‌شوند.
در پیشنهاد، نمونه‌ای از مقاله یا رپورتاژ، ترجیحاً در حوزه فناوری یا B2B، ارائه کنید و در چند خط توضیح دهید چگونه ارزش یک عبارت کم‌جست‌وجو را برای تولید محتوا ارزیابی می‌کنید. زمان تحویل و هزینه پیشنهادی را جداگانه برای تدوین برنامه، بازنویسی مقاله، نگارش مقاله جدید و رپورتاژ اعلام کنید.

items.title: Senior SEO Specialist
items.description:
Senior SEO Specialist
Are you an exceptional SEO specialist who loves the technical detail, thinks commercially and gets things done?
Connected Media Group is looking for a Senior SEO Specialist to join our award-winning independent media agency in Thirroul HQ on the beautiful South Coast.
This is a hands-on role for an experienced agency SEO specialist who knows how to turn strong technical foundations and smart search strategy into commercial results.
You’ll work closely with our SEO Director and growing SEO team across a portfolio of major clients, owning day-to-day search performance across traditional SEO and AI-driven discovery.
We’re looking for someone curious, technically strong and relentlessly focused on performance.

Why work at Connected?
This is a rare opportunity to continue a serious SEO career on the South Coast - without compromising on the calibre of work, clients, learning, or ambition.
Be part of a high-performing, supportive team that sets a high bar, challenges each other and backs each other to do great work.
Work closely with experienced leaders across SEO, strategy, media and AI-driven search.
Enjoy a team culture with regular social events, wellbeing initiatives and community and charity programs.
Keep sharpening your craft through in-house training, professional courses and continuous learning.
Work where SEO is a core capability, with a clear focus on commercial impact.
We work together in our new custom-built Thirroul HQ office four days a week, and from home on Fridays.

Our team is built around our values: Curiosity, Accountability, Heart & Challenger.

The role
You’ll own the day-to-day performance of accounts, working alongside our Search team and client account managers to turn strategy into action.
You’ll be highly hands-on across technical SEO, relevancy, authority, UX, and the evolving search landscape, including AI-driven search.

What You’ll be Doing:
Own day-to-day SEO performance across major client accounts.
Turn strategy, audits and data into clear priorities, roadmaps and actions.
Identify and execute quick wins while building toward long-term growth.
Lead technical SEO and AI-search audits, and work with clients to get fixes implemented.
Build and implement keyword, query and prompt-relevance strategies, and track impact.
Drive on-page and foundational optimisation.
Bring UX and conversion thinking into SEO.
Constantly monitor rankings, visibility, traffic and conversions to understand what is working and what needs to change.
Work with account managers to communicate recommendations and results.
Share knowledge generously across the Connected team.

What we’re looking for:
The sweet spot for this role is ~5 years of Search experience, but we're open to candidates with more or less. Experience in a large or sophisticated agency environment is essential.

Technically strong - You enjoy understanding how websites work and solving complex SEO problems.
Commercially minded - You care about leads, revenue, acquisition and business growth - not just rankings or visibility.
Hands-on and proactive - At Connected, everyone gets into the detail. This is a highly executional role.
Curious and accountable - Search is changing quickly, and you’ll naturally be experimenting, learning and challenging established approaches.
Fast and organised. You can manage multiple accounts and priorities without compromising quality.
A strong communicator. You can explain complex SEO issues clearly to colleagues and clients.

You’ll bring strong technical SEO experience and be able to demonstrate hands-on capability across areas such as site architecture, crawlability, relevance, on-page optimisation, authority, UX and AI search/AEO.

You’ll also have practical experience with tools such as GSC, GA4, Screaming Frog and SEMrush, and be confident working with WordPress, Shopify, CMS platforms, CSS and large, technically complex websites.

Agency experience is essential. Open to Australian residents only.

If you’re excited about the opportunity, we would love to meet you. Apply now and tell us:
Why you want to join Connected Media Group.
The SEO result you’re most proud of.

items.title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
items.description:
Job Description: SEO, AEO, GEO & Content Specialist
The XL Academy
Department: Digital Marketing
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience: 1–3 years preferred
About the Role
The XL Academy is looking for a skilled and results-driven SEO, AEO, GEO & Content Specialist who can independently manage on-page SEO, off-page SEO, technical SEO, Local SEO, Google Business Profile, content writing, and AI search optimization.
The candidate will be responsible for improving the academy's organic visibility across Google Search, Google Maps, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity, with a focus on increasing relevant website traffic, brand authority, and qualified student enquiries.
Key Responsibilities
1. On-Page SEO
Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, and competitor analysis.
Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, image alt text, and website content.
Optimize course pages, landing pages, blogs, FAQs, and internal linking.
Identify keyword cannibalization, duplicate content, and content optimization opportunities.
Implement relevant schema markup and structured data.
Improve content relevance, readability, topical authority, and search visibility.
2. Off-Page SEO & Link Building
Develop ethical link-building strategies to earn high-quality, relevant backlinks.
Conduct competitor backlink analysis and identify link-building opportunities.
Execute guest posting, digital PR, outreach, and content promotion.
Build brand authority through relevant mentions, industry publications, and quality citations.
Monitor referring domains, backlink quality, lost links, and spam-related risks.
Track backlink growth and its impact on organic search performance.
3. Technical SEO
Conduct technical SEO audits and resolve crawling, indexing, and website structure issues.
Optimize XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, and structured data.
Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile usability.
Use Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and tools such as Screaming Frog.
Coordinate with developers to implement technical improvements.
4. AEO, GEO & AI Search Optimization
Optimize content for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and Large Language Model Optimization (LLMO).
Structure content to answer conversational queries clearly and accurately.
Improve the chances of the academy being cited or referenced in AI-generated answers.
Strengthen brand entity consistency, topical authority, semantic relevance, and content credibility.
Monitor brand mentions and citations across AI-powered search platforms where measurable.
Research competitors' AI search visibility and implement improvement strategies.
5. Google Business Profile & Local SEO
Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles for relevant academy locations.
Improve Google Maps visibility through accurate business information, categories, photos, and updates.
Optimize location-specific keywords and local landing pages.
Manage customer reviews and maintain consistent business listings across relevant directories.
Track profile performance, calls, website clicks, direction requests, and local enquiries.
6. SEO Content Writing
Write original, high-quality SEO-friendly blogs, website pages, course descriptions, landing pages, and FAQs.
Develop content as per our courses.
Create content aligned with keyword intent, user needs, and AI search discovery.
Update existing content based on search performance and emerging opportunities.
Use AI writing tools responsibly, ensuring factual accuracy, originality, and human editing.
7. Analytics & Performance Reporting
Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, impressions, clicks, backlinks, and conversions.
Track Local SEO performance and AI citations or mentions where measurable.
Prepare monthly reports with actionable recommendations.
Focus on qualified organic enquiries and business growth rather than rankings alone.
Required Skills
Practical experience in on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and technical SEO.
Knowledge of AEO, GEO, LLMO, and AI search optimization.
Hands-on Google Business Profile and Local SEO management.
Strong SEO content writing, editing, and keyword research skills.
Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, Google Keyword Planner, and SEO tools.
Understanding of schema markup, semantic SEO, internal linking, and backlink analysis.
Familiarity with WordPress or other website content management systems.
Strong analytical, research, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently manage multiple SEO and content activities.
Preferred Qualifications
1–3 years of relevant SEO or digital marketing experience.
A portfolio demonstrating improvements in organic traffic, keyword rankings, or local visibility.
Practical AEO/GEO experiments or AI search optimization case studies.
Familiarity with Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, and AI visibility monitoring tools.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Growth in organic traffic and relevant keyword visibility.
Improvements in technical SEO health and content quality.
Quality backlinks and relevant referring domains.
Google Business Profile visibility and local enquiries.
AI search mentions and citations where measurable.
Growth in qualified organic leads and website conversions.

items.description:
🔴 متخصص سئو سایت تخصصی پلیمر و پلی‌یورتان

🔹 برای توسعه سئوی سایت تخصصی در حوزه مواد پلیمری و پلی‌یورتان، به دنبال یک متخصص سئو مجرب هستیم. هدف ما رشد ارگانیک و اصولی سایت است و ترجیح می‌دهیم همکاری به صورت بلندمدت و حرفه‌ای شکل بگیرد.
شیوه‌های همکاری (لطفاً در پیشنهاد خود مشخص کنید کدام روش را ترجیح می‌دهید):
روش اول (مدیریت کامل): مسئولیت تحقیق کلمات کلیدی، تولید یا نظارت بر محتوا، سئوی محصولات/مقالات و تمام امور سئو به‌صورت یکجا بر عهده متخصص باشد.
روش دوم (همکاری با تیم محتوا): تولید محتوا توسط نویسنده دیگری انجام می‌شود؛ در این روش، متخصص سئو وظیفه استراتژی، تدوین بریف برای نویسنده، سئوی صفحات محصولات و نظارت بر کیفیت محتواهای هفتگی (۲ الی ۳ محتوا در هفته) را بر عهده خواهد داشت.
شرح وظایف:
تدوین استراتژی سئو و تحقیق کلمات کلیدی هدف در حوزه پلیمر
سئو و بهینه‌سازی کدهای داخلی و صفحات محصولات سایت
همکاری و ارتباط مؤثر با نویسنده محتوا جهت انتشار منظم ۲ الی ۳ محتوا در هفته (در روش دوم)
پیشنهاد و اجرای برنامه‌های رپورتاژ آگهی (با همکاری صمیمانه در انتخاب رسانه‌ها و تهیه متن، و تأمین بودجه رپورتاژ از سوی کارفرما)
بررسی مداوم سایت، لینک‌سازی داخلی و بهبود رتبه کلمات کلیدی
ارائه گزارش پیشرفت منظم ماهانه
مهارت‌ها و شرایط مورد انتظار:
تسلط کامل به سئوی داخلی و اصول بهینه‌سازی سایت
تجربه اجرایی موفق در سایت‌های صنعتی، تخصصی یا فروشگاهی
توانایی ارتباط مؤثر و هدایت روند محتوا
آشنایی با ابزارهای تحلیل و سئو (گوگل سرچ کنسول و…)
در پیشنهاد خود لطفاً موارد زیر را ذکر کنید:
نمونه‌کارهای موفق در زمینه سئو
مشخص کردن روش انتخابی همکاری (روش اول یا دوم)
